s.how: Push an almond into each of 24 pitted prunes. Wrap each in a third of a bacon rasher, secure with a toothpick and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

s.note: the walk home in the downpour
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread on the outside and fill 4 with 200g grated cheddar. Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers and serve with 800ml hot tomato soup in mugs for dunking.

m.how: Fry 600g diced chicken breast in butter, then add 200g sliced mushrooms and 1 diced red capsicum. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 300ml cream and 125ml stock and simmer 8 minutes until thick. Spoon into 8 puff pastry cases baked at 200C for 15 minutes.

w.note: the cake Kathy jumps out of
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and a drop of pink colouring, stack and cover the layers, then shower with sprinkles.

d.note: the toast at the studio party
d.how: Simmer 100g sugar with 100ml water and the zest of 2 lemons until dissolved, cool and add the juice of 4 lemons. Pour 40ml into each of 4 coupe glasses and top with chilled sparkling water and a lemon twist.
